<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Use date-only ISO strings such as "2026-11-03". Use value for a single date or range with start and end for a range. When mode is omitted, providing range selects range mode. Each range endpoint can be null.

## Usage

```ts
import { datePicker } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/date-picker';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/date-picker`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-datepicker"></a>

### `shadcn.DatePicker`

This is a JSON composition.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Default `false` |
| `locale` | `string` | Default `"en-US"` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Default `"Pick a date"` |
| `value` | `string \| null` | Default `null` |
| `max` | `string \| null` |  |
| `min` | `string \| null` |  |
| `mode` | `"single" \| "range"` |  |
| `range` | `{ start: string \| null, end: string \| null }` | no extra fields |

No slots.

| Event | `value` in payload | Codec and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string \| null` | — |
| `rangeChange` | `{ start: string \| null, end: string \| null }` | no extra fields |

#### Example View

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "example",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.DatePicker",
    "inputs": {
      "mode": "range",
      "range": {
        "start": "2026-11-03",
        "end": "2026-11-06"
      },
      "min": "2026-11-01",
      "max": "2026-11-30",
      "locale": "en-US"
    }
  }
}
```
